source_name: OpenStreetMap planet or Geofabrik regional extracts

confidence_in_this_row: HIGH counts verified 2026-09-30 via taginfo official API
notes: share-alike binds the derived DATABASE not the prose. Publishing the page is fine; redistributing the data layer obliges ODbL

what_it_provides: stable identifiers, multilingual labels, coordinates, inception, heritage status, images via Commons
rate_limits: SPARQL endpoint has a 60s query timeout and courtesy limits
confidence_in_this_row: HIGH already held and already assessed

what_it_provides: images for landmarks and museums
licence: CC BY-SA or CC0 per file, varies
confidence_in_this_row: MEDIUM per-file licence must be checked

what_it_provides: restaurants, cafes, bars, pubs, gyms, coworking, nightclubs, malls
notes: the durable city x category page is the winnable unit here, not the venue page

what_it_provides: ratings, reviews, photos, opening hours, popularity

notes: the strongest lawful alternative to Google Places for commercial reuse. Worth a spike

what_it_provides: n/a

what_it_provides: event listings plus ticket links

notes: Ticketmaster is out of scope here. Any affiliate route needs the terms read before a single page ships
